asr.note: Sherpa pip wheel: cpu only. Vulkan/DML not in this build (falls back). AMD GPU needs custom sherpa+DirectML build.

streaming.note: Release=stop NEW record only. Flush queue+model until STT done. Stream every word.

hotkey.note: F11 hold = STT. Writes to focused/last-click window. Not Grok-only.

inject.note: PC-wide: mouse click target or foreground. Never force Grok.
